BEN.note: ASIN floats AI rules as an orientation, not in force; no rule, draft or authority on AI harms is stated.
Only a general remark that AI is used in public administrations; no named body or system.
ASIN suggests a classification doctrine with no legal vehicle, authority or timetable; not a draft.
Only a general remark on AI for decision support in health and education; no named tool or body.
Nothing on AI built or hosted in Benin.

facts.fact: ASIN's September 2026 bulletin, reported by La Marina BJ, says the Code du numerique and the personal data protection regime are the national legal base in force.

BEN.note: Nothing on the national ID system.
